item.title: Cheese Paper: a text editor specifically designed for writing
item.description:
📝 Cheese Paper stores notes and other information directly with each scene in a minimal file format. Cheese Paper keeps your notes visible as you're writing the scene. Cheese Paper also plays nicely with syncing programs - if you sync project files that are saved on your computer, Cheese Paper will automatically load your changes while it's still running.
🔗 Read more: https://brie.gay/cheese-paper/
